7: In an acute triangle $ABC$, $|AC|=5$ and $|AB|=8$. The area of this triangle equals $10\sqrt3$. Compute the radius of the circle circumscribed on this triangle.
8: Points $A=(-5,5)$ and $C=(8,6)$ are opposite vertices of isosceles trapezoid $ABCD$, in which $AB\parallel CD$. The line with equation $y=2x$ is the axis of symmetry of this trapezoid. Compute the coordinates of vertices $B$ and $D$, and the area of this trapezoid.
10: Given is square $ABCD$ with side length 2. On sides $BC$ and $CD$, points $E$ and $F$, different from the vertices, are chosen such that $|CE|=|DF|=x$. Compute the value of $x$ for which the area of triangle $AEF$ is smallest, and compute that area.
11: One number is drawn from among all four-digit numbers with digits from the set $\{1,2,3\}$. Compute the probability of the event that the sum of all digits of the drawn number equals 7.
12: In triangular pyramid $ABCS$ with base $ABC$ and apex $S$, we have $|AB|=|AC|=|SB|=|SC|=9$ and $|AS|=|BC|=8$. Compute the volume of this pyramid.
